scripts.text:
[Stephen]
Guess what I've got?
A tasty treat not easily found in Midgard....
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
猜猜我有什么？
一种在米德加尔特不易找到的美味糖果……

scripts.text:
[Stephen]
Chocolate!
That's right, don't you love chocolate.... I do.
And you are in luck, because I'm selling them for only 5,000 zeny a piece!
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
巧克力！
没错，你不喜欢巧克力吗……我喜欢。
而且你很幸运，因为我每块只卖5,000泽尼！

scripts.text: I want some chocolate!
scripts.translation: 我想要一些巧克力！

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Stephen]
You don't want any chocolate?
I'm telling you! You'll regret it!
You better get some now... you won't come across Chocolate like this ever again!
Think it over and visit me again sometime.
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
你不想要巧克力吗？
我告诉你！你会后悔的！
最好现在就买一些……你再也遇不到这样的巧克力了！
好好考虑一下，有空再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Stephen]
Hah!
I knew it!
But I can't sell you more than 5 at once... but, if you really need more....
you can come back again.
So how many do you want?
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
哈！
我就知道！
不过我一次最多只能卖给你5个……但是，如果你真的需要更多……
你可以再来。
那么你想要多少个？

scripts.text:
[Stephen]
I'm sorry, but I can't give you that many.
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
抱歉，我不能给你那么多。

scripts.text:
[Stephen]
I'm sorry, but it seems you can't afford to buy these off me.
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
抱歉，看来你买不起这些。

scripts.text:
[Stephen]
There you go!
You can give that to someone as a gift, or enjoy it yourself!
Mmm... sweet chocolate...
Visit me anytime...!
scripts.translation:
[斯蒂芬]
给你！
你可以把它当作礼物送给别人，或者自己尽兴享用！
嗯……甜甜的巧克力……
随时欢迎再来……！

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
You know what? The chocolate that my boyfriend sells are from me!
I made them by myself.
scripts.translation:
[杰妮]
你知道吗？我男朋友卖的巧克力都是我做的！
是我亲手制作的。

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
You know ... In cetain countries, there's a tradition of presenting chocolates to a person that you love...
They call it, ^3355FFValentine's Day^000000.
scripts.translation:
[杰妮]
你知道……在某些国家，有向心爱之人赠送巧克力的传统……
他们称之为^3355FF情人节^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
So I gave him my delicious chocolate...
And then he made me cook a lot more...
And now he is selling them to everyone.
I guess he really enjoyed it.
But, I do feel good when people buy something I have made.
scripts.translation:
[杰妮]
所以我给了他美味的巧克力……
然后他让我做了更多……
现在他把它们卖给所有人。
我想他真的很享受。
不过，当人们购买我制作的东西时，我也感觉很好。

scripts.text:
[Jainie]
It would be great if you bought some too...
I will be making chocolates for a while so...
scripts.translation:
[杰妮]
如果你也买一些就好了……
我还会制作一段时间的巧克力，所以……

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Yes?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
什么事？

scripts.text: I want some hand made chocolate...
scripts.translation: 我想要一些手工巧克力……

scripts.text: I'm lost, sorry to bother you.
scripts.translation: 我迷路了，抱歉打扰你。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Oh... well, if you want me to make some of my special Hand Made Chocolate....
You will need to give me at least ^0000FF 3 Chocolates^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
哦……好吧，如果你想让我制作一些特制的手工巧克力……
你至少需要给我^0000FF 3块巧克力^000000。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
That's right, only ^0000FF 3 Chocolates^000000
Bring them to me and you'll get what you came for.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
没错，只要^0000FF 3块巧克力^000000
把它们带给我，你就能得到你想要的东西。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
See You.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
再见。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Well, I just might be able to fulfill your needs...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
嗯，我或许能满足你的需求……

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
I'm sorry, you don't have enough Chocolate Bars to do this.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
抱歉，你没有足够的巧克力棒来进行这个操作。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
You got 3 pieces of pure chocolate, I see.
Give them to me...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
我看你有3块纯巧克力。
把它们给我……

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Ok, now I will only create my special hand made chocolates if you promise to use it wisely.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
好的，现在只要你承诺明智地使用，我才会制作我的特制手工巧克力。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
....Hmmmmmm.....
Well...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
……嗯……
好吧……

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Here.
I hope you give it to someone special, because its a special chocolate.
As you know... only I can create this.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
给你。
我希望你把它送给特别的人，因为这是特别的巧克力。
如你所知……只有我能制作这个。

scripts.text:
[Carl Orleans]
Enjoy.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔·奥尔良]
尽兴。
